funpay_market_review_sales.scope: Observed AION2 currency reviews including shops, all stocks, prices and server counts; summary only.
limitations: Partial saved profile and pagination coverage; not all platform sales.
Month labels do not identify order dates or selected-day totals.
Mixed-product profiles contribute only reviews explicitly identifying currency; unknown products excluded.
Currency-only historical profiles use the accepted assortment assumption, not confirmed order categories.
Cross-region shops cannot be allocated to one region; regional filters omit them.
G2G Sold and review counts have different coverage and periods; totals are not directly comparable.

funpay_ranking_policy.meaning: One suitable review is counted as a sale by agreed HRYU Radar policy. Sales without reviews are unobserved; not calibrated sale probability.
funpay_ranking_policy.normalization: Income relative to best eligible payout; review activity shrunk toward the positive cohort median by checked sellers and blended with shrunk total review sales; competition saturated around cohort median; price change absolute soft scale; source load clipped at 100. No percentile ranks.
funpay_ranking_policy.missing_data_policy: No reviewed eligible sellers: the review activity component is excluded from the score and its weight is redistributed across the remaining components; no neutral factor and no stock fallback. Zero observed reviews is not zero total sales.
funpay_ranking_policy.recommendation_policy: Main top requires at least one review-based sale and at least one audited eligible seller. No minimum stock-change sellers.
funpay_ranking_policy.ordering_policy: Main top uses review sales >0; risk list lacks review support and orders by payout. Listing movements do not influence v6.
funpay_ranking_policy.activity_normalization: Shrunk intensity (n*sales_per_seller + k*median)/(n+k) with k=activity_shrinkage_sellers, blended by activity_volume_share with shrunk total review sales against the positive cohort median; observed zero sales stay zero; no daily extrapolation or volume inference.
funpay_ranking_policy.weight_change_reason: 2026-10-19 user decision: sales 50%, income 25%, competition 5%, price change 10%, load 10%.

loot_price_source.method: Current API price field for each server; not sold_avg_price

membership.official_review_scope: Indexed official product notice: price changed from15.00 to14.99 and30-day term; direct HTML shell has no rendered article text
membership.coverage: all characters of the subscribing account on the purchased server; other account/server subscription charged separately
membership.coverage_review_scope: Fan reference quoting the official notice, corroborated by indexed original-notice mirror and player reports
membership.price_basis: USD official product price; CBR reference conversion, not bank/card checkout cost

bound_vendor.scope: Six normal Conquest variants; main and all five alts farm the same dungeon for illustration. All eligible bound drops sold to NPC; no gear kept/disenchanted; ordinary auction loot excluded. Expected quantity range not measured distribution. No bound reward penalties independently verified; all reward claims included. Consumables excluded. Vendor raw cards archived separately.

sale_fees.funpay_method: Rubles / bank card; Russia tariff as displayed in user screenshot

screenshot_discrepancy.chosen_by_user: 3% by tariff label; discrepancy not resolved

date_policy: Latest successful snapshot within each selected Moscow calendar day; exact endpoints required; no nearest-day fallback
price_policy: Exact change requires the same checked quote selection; approximate movement compares available per-million ruble benchmarks and is explicitly marked. RMTHub unknown-unit quotes are separate and excluded from income.
load_policy: Rating uses end-point source-labelled 24h mean. Sample means and counts are separate context.

event_policy.scenario_policy: A full-week scenario under rules for the chosen date, not prorated historical earnings. Events remain opt-in. Maintenance days have unknown exact boundaries.
event_policy.evidence: ENERGY_PATCH_2026-10-14.md; saved review of official patch and Steam announcement

quna_reference.formula: min(2M chest Quna / 2, 400K chest Quna * 2.5) * (5.99 / 400) * USD_RUB
limitations: Marginal unit-cost equivalent; not minimum cash top-up or exact 1M basket cost. Residual Quna retains value.
Cheapest displayed listings are not completed trades; stock quantity/depth and purchase limits unverified.
10M chests were not displayed in these tables; they are not assumed absent from the game.
Membership incremental cost, payment fees and taxes excluded. No unverified buyer tax added.
Chest creation/seller taxes are not added to a buyer benchmark; exact buyer conditions require game verification.
Questlog quotes and saved FunPay/G2G quotes are asynchronous; per-platform timestamps retained.
Reviews are a partial monthly observation, not exact trade counts or evidence of transactions at displayed prices.
Low sample means fewer than 5 observed reviews, an explicit diagnostic convention; no rating changes.
Official price notice checked in browser; later promotions and checkout-specific prices not verified.
quna_reference.validity_policy: manual_snapshot_review_window_24h; not a guarantee of live price
